# Proto-Vulp
Protogen-Vulpkanins played a large role in the current naming scheme of all Protogens, and it wasn't really even intetional on their part. Once contact was established between Humanity and Vulpkanins, ideas of transhumanism naturally flowed between the two species and culminated into the first inter-species transhumanist group, which would then quickly take on other members as more species were discovered.
A connection was quickly made between their apperance and a fictional human species- Protogen, and it didn't take long for the name to catch on after that.
## Racial Features - They [color=#1e90ff]can safely eat raw meat[/color] but are [color=#ffa500]poisoned by theobromine[/color]. - They get hungry and thirsty [color=#ffa500]50% faster[/color] but can metabolise chemicals [color=#1e90ff]25% faster[/color]. - Their blood is sulfur based and has a distinct yellow color. - Thanks to their claws they deal [color=red]3[/color] slash damage and [color=red]2[/color] pierce damage with their unarmed attacks. - Due to their thick fur, they take [color=#ffa500]25% more heat damage.[/color] and [color=#1e90ff]55% less cold damage[/color]. - On top of that, they receive [color=#1fb0ff](10%-30%-40%) slash and piercing damage resistance[/color] depending on their cybernetic choice. (Access your species specific loadout from the Appearance tab) - They have a [color=#1fb0ff]Built in MIDI player[/color] - Due to their mixed mechanical and biological nature, they can [color=#1fb0ff]heal with both chemicals and topicals, and welders and wires[/color], however [color=#ffa500]both methods are only 50% effective[/color]. - They are [color=#ffa500]damaged slightly and immobilised by EMPs[/color]. - They have an in-built [color=#1fb0ff]Trinary Radio Channel accessed with the key :D[/color] - Additionally, they cool down 70% slower and heat up 20% faster. - Their standard body heat is 37 degrees Celcius and they [color=#1e90ff]can withstand temperatures between -45 and 50 degrees Celcius[/color]. - They take [color=#1e90ff]50% less cold damage from freezing[/color] and [color=#ffa500]15% more damage from overheating[/color]. - They can see roughly [color=#1e90ff]1 tile further[/color].
## Canilunzt and Trinary The Vulpkanin language, known as Canilunzt, is composed of a series of grunts, barks, yips and howls as well as several tail and ear movements that Vulpkanin do instinctually. It is often described as very harsh on the throat and difficult to learn for species that lack ears or tails. Thanks to this instinctual understanding of tail and ear movements, Vulpkanin are capable of understanding most dogs and foxes. Like all other Protogens, they are also able to speak and understand Trinary, a language similar to binary but able to be spoken by most synthetics.
## Age and Names Vulpkanin are a somewhat shorter lived species, reaching adulthood at around 10 years of age and being capable to live up to 120 years. Their names are often given to them by their parents upon birth, following a naming scheme that has been described as "Germanic" by humans.
